report: T03 real local App Social foreground cost comparison

measurement_contract.entrypoint: The real snapshot-specific env.social.execute("send", {"text": PAYLOAD}, SocialContext) through PresenceRouter, content preparation, Social receipts, ledger and local App delivery.
measurement_contract.input_payload: Foreground App Social benchmark: 同一条消息，保持原始内容。

arrival_modes.sequential: Closed loop: one request at a time, next after prior completion.
arrival_modes.batch_4: Closed batches: four requests launched together; await all four, then launch next batch. No added sleep.

measurement_contract.latency_clock: time.perf_counter around the real Social.execute call, excluding setup, verification queries and warmup.
measurement_contract.throughput: Completed measured requests divided by measured closed-loop phase wall time. This is not a fixed-arrival-rate SLA.
measurement_contract.percentiles: p50 is median; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), aggregated across the three equal-sized trials.
measurement_contract.sql_attribution: SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute grouped by a request ContextVar inherited by commit tasks. Requests without an owner are recorded as background and excluded. Measured background SQL/transaction counts were zero.
measurement_contract.transaction_count: BEGIN_IMMEDIATE statements and writer contexts are counted separately from SQLAlchemy begin/commit/rollback events; read-session rollback events are not failed writes.
measurement_contract.writer_entry_elapsed: Time from invoking immediate_session until it yields: includes FIFO admission, connection checkout, BEGIN and scheduling. It is not pure FIFO wait.
measurement_contract.writer_context_elapsed: Time from yielded immediate_session to context exit, including body, flush, commit and cleanup. It is not standalone SQL-lock duration or standalone commit time.
measurement_contract.instrumentation: Only the test harness wraps immediate_session and attaches SQLAlchemy observers; both revisions use the identical probe. Runtime source was not modified.
measurement_contract.run_order: Baseline three trials, then current three trials, on the same machine and shared dependency environment. No CPU affinity or machine-wide load isolation.
measurement_contract.setup: Both revisions clone the same baseline fixture seed. The current seed is a byte copy followed by the real 0155 migration outside measurement. The fixture schema is explicitly marked as its known 0154 baseline for this test-only migration setup; no production DB was used.
measurement_contract.external_effects: Fake model only during App context setup; measured sends make no additional model calls, no external network calls and no real platform sends.

environment.filesystem: WSL native ext4 under /tmp; source and SQLite data are not on /mnt/d/DrvFS during the run.

tradeoffs: Current local atomic settlement reduces writer contexts/commits from three to two and SQL executions from 51 to 46 per request.
One merged writer context is longer: sequential per-context p95 rises from 14.79 ms to 22.95 ms; batch_4 per-context p95 rises from 15.75 ms to 26.90 ms.
Per-request cumulative writer context time and foreground latency both fall. The JSON preserves all per-context and per-request values rather than reporting only the favorable direction.
